name: adkit-ads
description: Ads Manager by AdKit: launch, manage and analyze PPC advertising campaigns on Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook Ads and Instagram Ads), TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Reddit Ads, Microsoft Ads and X Ads. Performance reporting, budgets, drafts, media uploads, and a library of 1M+ competitor ads. Uses the hosted AdKit MCP server.

adkit.description: Hosted AdKit MCP server (streamable HTTP). Signs in with OAuth in the browser on first connection; nothing to install.
